panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 3 panels (A, B, C). A: Panel A is an echocardiogram showing both the aorta and pulmonary artery originating from the right ventricle, which is the defining characteristic of Double Outlet Right Ventricle (DORV). B: Panel B is a CT scan showing malpositioned great vessels, consistent with the complex anatomy of DORV, as described in the caption. C: Panel C is a 3D CT reconstruction of the heart showing anomalous vessel positioning and pulmonary stenosis, associated with DORV.
